mapper.sql: dv.id, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.vin, v.lifecycle_stage, COALESCE(dv.stage_status, v.lifecycle_stage) AS stage_status, p.model_id, m.model_name, m.series, m.spec, m.model_code, p.year_make, p.exterior_color_id, ec.color_name AS exterior_color_name, p.interior_color_id, ic.color_name AS interior_color_name, a.dealer_id, d.dealer_code, d.dealer_name, dv.etd_to_dealer, dv.eta_to_dealer, dv.trolly_type, dv.fully_load, dv.received_date, dv.delivery_status, dv.remark7, dv.confirmed_by, dv.confirmed_at

FROM t_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_veh_delivery dv ON dv.vehicle_id = v.id AND dv.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_veh_production p ON p.vehicle_id = v.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_model m ON m.id = p.model_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_exterior_color ec ON ec.id = p.exterior_color_id AND ec.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_interior_color ic ON ic.id = p.interior_color_id AND ic.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_veh_allocation a ON a.vehicle_id = v.id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.stage_status = 'CONFIRMED' LEFT JOIN t_md_dealer d ON d.id = a.dealer_id AND d.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT dv.* FROM t_veh_delivery dv WHERE dv.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND dv.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
